decision_rules.if: Cliff vanishes on a larger host with same PG schema/code
Cliff worsens only as ledger_wallet/indexes grow; EXPLAIN seq scans or lock waits spike
Cliff persists on empty/small DB with same workers; CPU in ECDSA/JSON/Hibernate
Correctness breaks (overspend, duplicate settle, lost pending) even when TPS is fine
Accept TPS fine with skip-transaction-broadcast; collapses with fan-out on
Boot/restart hangs validating full chain after volume

empty_db_hot_path.instruction: On a wiped ledger (or fresh compose volume), re-run: run_battery.py --skip-money --skip-wallets --skip-contention --skip-two-node-accept --throughput-duration-s 20.0 --throughput-pairs 10. If tx/s stays near the populated baseline, primary layer is source_code (ECDSA/HTTP/ORM), not PostgreSQL row count.
